batch_notes: Putin is the clear low anchor: full-scale invasion, annexation, and sustained unlawful civilian harm outweighed the limited negotiation and grain-corridor signals.

The middle band is split between mixed coercive/security cases (Xi, Abiy, Erdogan, Bolsonaro, Modi) and diplomacy-heavy but limited-effect cases (Bangladesh, Egypt, Vietnam, Pakistan, Nigeria, Thailand).

High scores are reserved for rulers whose records were visibly diplomacy-led and law-oriented without direct aggression; Scholz, Jokowi, Hasina, Kishida, Marcos, AMLO, and Biden all land there for different reasons.
Where attribution is mostly state, cabinet, or ministry level, I discounted personal credit slightly rather than treating institutional posture as private command.
